paragraphs.text: Tok-Tok (TOHK-tohk; Japanese: トクトク; rōmaji : Toku-Toku ) was an old akki shaman on Kamigawa famous for his ability to survive almost anything.

Tok-Tok once lived at the mouth of an open volcano in the Sokenzan Mountains . He spent his days skirting from rock to rock across the volcano's molten surface. Unfortunately, one day, he fell in. After several agonizing moments inside the lava, he hauled himself up onto a rock: his tough akki skin and durable shell had saved him. Soon, the lava cooled, encasing his body in volcanic rock. He survived the incident and became impervious to fire; and thus, Tok-Tok, Volcano Born was born.
